item.title: Flooding/Water Leakage, 30th August
item.description:
​I am writing to report significant water leakage and accumulation at the following location within the Lambeth borough: ​ ​I have observed substantial amounts of water accumulating on the road, forming large puddles. This issue is causing inconvenience and potential hazards for both pedestrians and road users. It appears to be stemming from a leak or a drainage issue. ​I have attached a photograph of the situation for your reference. ​I kindly request that you investigate this matter as soon as possible and take the necessary steps to resolve the issue.

item.title: Yet more flytipping at this hotspot, 30th August
item.description:
On Friday evening I spotted this double mattress which had been dumped against the side wall of Brewers on Clifton Road. By Saturday evening after some heavy rain, it had fallen down onto the pavement, completely blocking pedestrian access. Due to this obstruction, people are having to step into the road, which is very busy with traffic turning in and out of Park View Road. It is extremely dangerous for parents with small children, those pushing buggies, pulling shopping trollies or suitcases, plus those with mobility issues, particularly wheelchair users. I'm fed up of reporting flytipping at this same spot. Sending a clean up team out every time is not the answer. You need to install CCTV asap to catch the culprits in the act and prosecute them.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 1, Clifton Road, Welling, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
